name: Embrace the Endless Waves
take: Skill casts refund a point of Trance, and Graceful Step, Flickering Reverie, and Perception Drain all gain 50% to their multipliers — plus Perception Drain becomes immune to interruption. The engine self-primes and every payoff fattens, in one node.

name: Surrender to the Illusive Reverie
take: The ult now inflicts Hazy Dream on cast, and HER Jolt detonations hit 245% harder. The trap-setting playstyle stops needing the skill to arm the dream — the wave itself does it, and the detonations graduate to headline damage.

name: Gaze into the Abyss
take: Flowing Suffocation gains 370% — the single biggest number on her chain — and casting it drops her straight into Mirage. Ult, then immediately the enhanced kit, no Trance ceremony required. The abyss gazes back and it is FURIOUS.

name: Behold Your Own Soul
take: Healing Bonus +25% while in Mirage. Stacked with "Cure" the dream state becomes a genuine second healer's kit — the deeper she goes, the more she gives back.

name: Rest in Your Reflection
take: Diffusion's Dreamweaver cap rises by five, from 21 coordinated attacks per ult to 26. More jellyfish. There are never enough jellyfish.

name: Fall, Fall... and Fall Deeper into the Dream
take: Phantom Sting gains 80% and casting the ult makes her damage ignore 30% of DEF for 10s. The Mirage strings graduate from utility weaving to real damage in their own right — and the dream stops being an illusion at all.
